# Skills this repo still carries in skills/ although their home is the skills library
# (skills-library skills/HOMES.json). Shrink-only: scripts/sync_skills_library.py check fails on
# an overlap missing from this list AND on a listed name that no longer overlaps.
#
# While a name is listed, Mission Control loads the skills/ copy, not skills-library/, so
# nothing it loads today changes. To remove a line: merge any PDO-only content into the
# library copy, then delete skills/<name>/ here and sync.

# path reference to skills/<name>/ in this repo is checked. "diverged" = content differs.
